title: EventEnvelope
description: Domain event envelope (planning/06 §4). Mirrored by `EventEnvelope` in @ai-stylist/shared-kernel; consumers must tolerate unknown fields.

id.description: `evt_` ULID; idempotency key and outbox row id

sequence.description: Per-aggregate monotonic sequence assigned in the producing transaction

correlationId.description: Correlation id of the logical operation (doc 14 §2): minted by the client per operation (or by the API when a request carried none or an invalid one) and carried request → outbox → job → worker as `x-correlation-id`. Our own correlation metadata, never user data. 1–128 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]` (a UUID, ULID or `corr-…`); producers and consumers accept exactly this pattern

causationId.description: Id of the event or request that caused this one; absent for roots

consentScope.description: Consent scope required to process the payload (doc 11); present when it touches sensitive data

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context `traceparent` of the producing span (doc 14 §3), so one trace covers request → outbox → job → worker. Carries trace context only, never user data; absent when the producer was not traced

payload.description: Event-specific payload; the per-event schema (e.g. demo.event.json) narrows it
